project-radial-queue-desc: Queues radial and shortcut inputs until an action can run, preventing missed inputs and repeat clicking during animations.
project-radial-queue-reception: Nexus Mods: 207 endorsements · 11.2k downloads. Players praise the queued inputs for cutting down on repeated button presses.
project-immersivehud-desc: A Valheim mod that hides HUD elements dynamically based on configurable in-game conditions for a more immersive experience.
project-immersivehud-reception: Nexus Mods: 15 endorsements · 598 downloads. Players praise the dynamic HUD and thank the author for continuing to maintain it.
project-2: Detection and warning of game in vicinity of roads using deep learning
project-2-desc: Development of a deep learning model and Python application for accurate real-time detection and warning of game close to public roads.
project-1-desc: A Valheim building quality-of-life mod with a pipette for building and resource gathering, automatic tool selection, interaction while building, and quick hammer/repair hotkeys.
project-ezbuild-reception: Nexus Mods: 57 endorsements · 1.7k downloads. Players praise its useful building shortcuts and quality-of-life improvements.
project-markitdown-desc: A browser port of Microsoft's MarkItDown that turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and more into Markdown. Python runs in the browser through WebAssembly, so files are never uploaded.
project-markitdown-open-label: Open MarkItDown Web in this browser
project-markitdown-github-label: View the MarkItDown Web source code on GitHub
project-gen-center-desc: A self-hosted studio for AI video and image generation on ComfyUI. Three pipelines: YouTube Shorts from a topic (Gemini script and narration, stock footage, a lip-synced AI presenter, automatic upload), films up to 10 minutes from one image, and image sets from text or by editing, inpainting and expanding. Gemini or local LLMs write the prompts, one GPU queue resumes and recovers from crashes, and a responsive panel runs it from a phone anywhere.
project-gen-center-github-label: View the gen-center source code on GitHub
project-local-llm-host-desc: A self-hosted chat for local LLMs. Drop GGUF models in a folder and chat with them from your PC or phone, anywhere over Tailscale. llama.cpp loads a model on the first message and unloads it when idle; conversations are kept on the server and shared across devices, with streaming Markdown replies, images for vision models, edit and regenerate, and a context meter. It can start headless in the background when you sign in to Windows, and nothing leaves your own GPU.
project-local-llm-host-github-label: View the local-llm-host source code on GitHub
garden-deepfield-desc: Explore the observable universe in your browser. Fly from the Solar System to the edge of the cosmic web, with 2.8 million real stars, 6,400 exoplanets, 284,000 asteroids and comets, 44,000 galaxies and real-time ray-traced black holes. Scrub through time, land on planets and plan space missions.
garden-deepfield-open-label: Open Deep Field in this browser
garden-deepfield-github-label: View the Deep Field source code on GitHub
garden-hivemind-desc: An interactive full-screen simulation of AI agents and neural nets at work. The agents think, message each other, lay plans, vote their way to consensus and call trends before the market sees them. Give them an objective, drag agents together to start a conversation, prioritise tasks, call votes, recruit new agents and zoom in on the action.
garden-hivemind-github-label: View the Hivemind source code on GitHub
garden-breachline-desc: Type the perfect movie hack at your own pace. Every key writes the code for you on the left. Press Enter when a phase is written and watch it run on the right: radar sweeps, port scans, a firewall coming down, passwords cracking, cameras on a loop, files decrypting and leaving the building, and finally a vault swinging open.
